primary_task: query experimental MS/MS to reference experimental MS/MS identity ranking on an identical candidate-molecule axis

same_axis_main_table.training_overlap_rule: Report development and external roles separately; never reuse GNPS or Enveda as independent confirmation.

same_axis_main_table.contamination_boundary: Large self-supervised pretraining includes MassIVE/GNPS-family spectra; exact exposure is not fully excluded.

same_axis_main_table.figshare_network_note: Direct archive download returned HTTP 403 from this network; the authors' official Hugging Face Space supplied the exact executable checkpoint.
same_axis_main_table.license_boundary: Figshare model/data are CC BY 4.0; cloned code repository has no explicit license.
same_axis_main_table.contamination_boundary: Training uses GNPS/MoNA/MTBLS1572-derived data; GNPS comparison is consumed development only.
Trained directly on filtered GNPS; GNPS comparison is contaminated development evidence, not external confirmation.
Public model trained on GNPS AllPositive.

same_axis_auxiliary_table.task_boundary: Supervised chemical-similarity scoring rather than exact-identity training; report as an auxiliary comparator.
Learned spectrum-pair structural-similarity score rather than an exact-identity-specific objective; optional same-axis auxiliary comparator.
same_axis_auxiliary_table.contamination_boundary: Training uses GNPS-derived data; any GNPS result is contaminated development evidence.
same_axis_auxiliary_table.runtime_boundary: The official attention-gradient hook requires gradient-enabled inference and has high CPU-memory cost; use a small batch or GPU and report resource use.
same_axis_auxiliary_table.license_boundary: The official repository has no explicit software license; do not redistribute code or weights without permission.

native_system_or_non_axis_comparisons.exclusion_reason: Native system changes retrieval and depends on whole-library neighbourhood features. It cannot be inserted into a frozen small candidate graph and called same-axis.
Published retrieval protocol uses a 1.8M reference library with incomplete query coverage and commercial/internal data, so its absolute values cannot be mixed into the fixed-axis ladder.

Aligns a query spectrum to candidate molecular structures, not to experimental reference spectra. The strongest reported model/checkpoints are not publicly executable on the frozen spectrum-to-spectrum axis.

Generative spectrum-to-molecule retrieval and reranking on MassSpecGym/MassRET-20k is a different candidate object and protocol; published Recall values cannot be inserted into the experimental-spectrum identity ladder.

Cross-modal spectrum-to-SMILES candidate retrieval on CASMI is not query-spectrum to reference-spectrum identity matching. No verified official runnable package/checkpoint for the present axis was located.
Candidate molecules are scored against spectra rather than query spectra being matched to experimental reference spectra. Keep in a separate task table.
